items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: I said, well, that's my brother.

ctx.x: I think she told somebody like Lomax once when he was working on his book That she was eleven years younger than uh Jelly? Jelly, your brother
Yeah, well I mean, I'm the seventh child and she's a third, see, so I don't know And Jelly was born in 85 and I'm born in 1900
He was really born in 85 because later he told somebody that he was born in 86
